title: Australian court orders bamboo hedge trimmed after neighbours' property dispute
summary_full: A legal battle arose between Leonard Clyde Lloyd and Susan Boyd Valstar over a bamboo hedge in Australia. The Land and Environment Court ordered the removal of bamboo growing on the boundary. Lloyd's complaints included property damage and reduced sunlight due to the bamboo's height. The court ruled that vegetation contributed minimally to fence damage and ordered equal cost sharing for its replacement.
